select tl.type as type, tl.id as id, tl.group_date as groupDate, tl.sort_instant as sortInstant, tl.title as title, tl.amount as amount from (
select 'SCHEDULE' as type, s.id as id, case when s.is_all_day = 1 then s.start_date else date(convert_tz(s.started_at, '+00:00', #{zoneOffset})) end as group_date, case when s.is_all_day = 1 then null else s.started_at end as sort_instant, 1 as type_priority, s.title as title, null as amount from schedule s where s.family_id = #{familyId} and s.deleted_at is null and (s.visibility = 'FAMILY' or (s.visibility = 'PARENTS' and #{isParent} = true) or (s.visibility = 'PRIVATE' and s.created_by = #{personId}) or (s.visibility = 'SHARED_PERSONAL' and (s.created_by = #{personId} or exists (select 1 from schedule_subject ss where ss.schedule_id = s.id and ss.family_id = #{familyId} and ss.deleted_at is null and ss.person_id = #{personId}))))
union all
select 'DIARY' as type, d.id as id, d.recorded_on as group_date, d.recorded_at as sort_instant, 2 as type_priority, d.title as title, null as amount from diary d where d.family_id = #{familyId} and d.deleted_at is null and (d.visibility = 'FAMILY' or (d.visibility = 'PARENTS' and #{isParent} = true) or (d.visibility = 'PRIVATE' and d.created_by = #{personId}) or (d.visibility = 'SHARED_PERSONAL' and (d.created_by = #{personId} or exists (select 1 from diary_subject ds where ds.diary_id = d.id and ds.family_id = #{familyId} and ds.deleted_at is null and ds.person_id = #{personId}))))
union all
select 'TRANSACTION' as type, t.id as id, date(convert_tz(t.occurred_at, '+00:00', #{zoneOffset})) as group_date, t.occurred_at as sort_instant, 3 as type_priority, t.memo as title, t.amount as amount from `transaction` t where t.family_id = #{familyId} and t.deleted_at is null and (t.visibility = 'FAMILY' or (t.visibility = 'PARENTS' and #{isParent} = true) or (t.visibility = 'PRIVATE' and t.created_by = #{personId}))
union all
select 'PHOTO' as type, p.id as id, date(convert_tz(p.taken_at, '+00:00', #{zoneOffset})) as group_date, p.taken_at as sort_instant, 4 as type_priority, null as title, null as amount from photo p left join diary d on d.id = p.diary_id and d.deleted_at is null where p.family_id = #{familyId} and p.deleted_at is null and p.taken_at is not null and ( (p.diary_id is not null and (d.visibility = 'FAMILY' or (d.visibility = 'PARENTS' and #{isParent} = true) or (d.visibility = 'PRIVATE' and d.created_by = #{personId}) or (d.visibility = 'SHARED_PERSONAL' and (d.created_by = #{personId} or exists (select 1 from diary_subject ds where ds.diary_id = d.id and ds.family_id = #{familyId} and ds.deleted_at is null and ds.person_id = #{personId}))))) or (p.diary_id is null and p.created_by = #{personId}) ) ) tl where tl.group_date between #{fromDate} and #{toDate} order by tl.group_date asc, (tl.sort_instant is not null) asc, tl.sort_instant asc, tl.type_priority asc
